verdict.rationale: Ollama's own docs say you can run larger models on Ollama's Cloud without downloading them. Cloud models can be called by API key with no local installation, and `ollama launch` works with local or cloud models. This is the story's core: offloading large models to a hosted tier. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the cloud tier, and detail on which very large models are offered and their usage limits.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can offload very large models to a hosted cloud tier without downloading them when my local hardware is insufficient

citations.quote: Run larger models on Ollama's Cloud without the download.

sets up and runs coding tools like Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex with local or cloud models
